specs.title: Booking link and QR generation
specs.why: Merchants convert walk-in traffic by displaying a scannable link in the shop.
specs.scope: After tenant confirmation, generate a branded booking URL and a downloadable QR PNG/PDF for printing.
tasks: Branded PDF layout with the logo
Downloadable from the dashboard and sent over WhatsApp
acceptance: The QR scans to the correct tenant page
The PDF prints cleanly at A5
The owner receives it over WhatsApp after setup

specs.title: No-show tracking
specs.why: No-show data is the input to risk scoring and deposit gating.
specs.scope: Owner marks bookings as `no_show` from the dashboard or by replying to the booking WhatsApp notification. Updates aggregate client stats.
tasks: WhatsApp shortcut reply on the booking notification
Client no-show count and rate fields
acceptance: Both surfaces correctly mark a no-show
The client profile reflects updated stats
A future booking cannot be marked as a no-show
